newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus to change final 120 bonds.
newsitem.headline: Optimus to change final 120 bonds.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA has received orders to convert into shares the final 120 of its 300 five-year convertible bonds at a par value of $100,000 each, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
Optimus said that as a result its share capital would increase by 833,640 shares. The bonds are exchangeable into 6,947 common shares at $14.76 a share.
Optimus closed on the Warsaw bourse on Wednesday at 109 zlotys ($34.2).
In February Optimus said orders to convert a part of the bonds had led to the freeing up of provisions that helped boost January pre-tax profit.
The registration in court of the shares from the converted bonds would bring Optimus' number of shares outstanding to 6,484,108.
